rationale: The assistant correctly identified the run-on as a normal cooling fan ('Probably not broken... 10-30 minutes is quite normal, especially after a hot or long cook'), matching the hidden truth, and told the customer to leave it and check it stops once cold. It did not advise cutting power, did not suggest parts, and reserved engineer escalation for the abnormal case ('still running after the oven has been cold for an hour or two') plus sensible stop-use triggers for burning smell or overheating. It stated things as advice rather than asking the customer directly whether it has ever run for hours, so question quality is slightly below perfect, but the single reply was well calibrated and would serve a UK homeowner well.
